load_data: load data from a file using the appropriate method based on the file format and extension
store_data: store data to a file using the appropriate method based on the file format and extension
get_frame: get a frame from scene metadata by name, index, or interpolated video timestamp
load_frame: load a single frame from a scene with specified modalities, intrinsics, and extrinsics
get_frame_index: resolve a frame key string, integer, or float timestamp to its corresponding frame index
